newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet premiums steady, cargo supply thin.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet premiums steady, cargo supply thin.

text.p: Jet trade in North West Europe was quiet on Monday, with supply meagre in the absence of August programmes, traders said.
The main cargo demand was for speculative storage at low numbers, but with only July barrels available little was moving.
Cargoes were talked at around August IPE +$16/17. August
IPE gas oil closed down $1 at $162.50, tugged lower by a sinking U.S. futures market.
Barges were inactive. First half August was notionally around August IPE +$17.50 but demand was thin and sellers were reluctant to offer at current levels.
In the Med sellers of Italian grade were looking for $7.50 over quotes high. Greek grade sellers were around a premium of $12, while Algerian was around $10.
